suggestions.text:
Suggested board for Tue 10 Nov (suggestions only, nothing changed). Board now: ULP 239.9 / P95 249.9 / Diesel 279.9 (ULP and P95 changed 4:42am today; diesel unchanged since 25 Sep). Delivered cost is tonight's 10 Nov Cairns set (ULP 1.9736, P95 2.0412, Diesel 2.3253), which is a 3.6c / 3.5c / 1.0c drop.
- ULP: board 239.9, cost 197.36 (217.10 inc GST), margin +22.80 -> hold 239.9. The cost drop widens margin; litres were soft today (863 L), so do not lift. If litres stay weak tomorrow, ease 1-2c toward 237.9 (still +20).
- P95: board 249.9, cost 204.12 (224.53 inc), margin +25.37 -> hold 249.9. Well over the +12 ceiling but 285 L was fine today and it sits 10c over ULP. Optional ease to 244.9 if you want it nearer the guide.
- Diesel: board 279.9, cost 232.53 (255.78 inc), margin +24.12 -> 274.9 (-5c, margin +19.12). Diesel litres were only 1206 L today vs about 2262 L on October Mondays. Caution: tank 3 diesel was at about 4% and tank 4 about 12% on tonight's dips, so low stock may have limited volume. Fix supply first; if stock is fine, the 5c cut is the suggestion.

basis.margin: Margin cpl inc GST = 100 × (average sell inc GST − delivered cost ex GST × 1.1)
basis.commission: Commission ex GST = sales ex GST − litres × delivered cost ex GST; daily total from commission workbook col D
basis.cost: Delivered cost ex GST $/L = Cairns TGP ex GST cpl / 100 + $0.0594/L freight
basis.board: Board prices are the latest recorded on the box, not read from the till
basis.targets: October $9,000 and November $9,500 approved targets only
